{{Quote|The story, by now, is an old and familiar one to anyone who's lived through it: Three years ago, with the Mandalorians beginning to threaten Taris's resource worlds of Vanquo, Tarnith, Suurja, and Jebble, the Republic suddenly changed its policy and offered protection to a world on the Outer Rim.|A news report by the Taris Holofeed|<ref name="Siege Edition">{{KOTORbackups|15}}</ref>}}
'''Tarnith''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated in the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]. It was a resource world for the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and in [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]], it began to be threatened by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] warriors. Subsequently the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a protective security cordon, the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]], around Taris. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] nevertheless eventually established both a staging area and an [[Armor/Legends|armor]]-and-[[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]-producing [[Neo-Crusader War Forge|War Forge]] on Tarnith.

==Description==
Tarnith was a terrestrial<ref name="KOTORCG" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Siege Edition" /> located in the [[Tarnith system/Legends|Tarnith system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Well, some of you may have seen some of our larger vessels, valiantly defending and delaying your forces at places with names such as Vanquo, Tarnith, and &mdash; yes &mdash; Serroco.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/interference20090929.html|text="Interference"|int=Interference|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
[[File:Tarisfull.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tarnith served as a resource world for Taris (pictured).]]
By [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]],<ref name="3966 BBY">"[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]," which establishes that Tarnith was a resource [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, was included in [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]], the events of which the issue itself and the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' date to [[3963 BBY]].</ref> Tarnith served as a resource world for [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a planet<ref name="Siege Edition" /> in the Ojoster [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Taris">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]]</ref> that was a [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-world]] and the home of the [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] company [[Lhosan Industries]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="3966 BBY" /> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, as part of its [[Mandalorian Wars|campaign of expansion]] throughout the Outer Rim,<ref name="KOTORCG" /> began threatening Tarnith and other Tarisian resource worlds. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] then extended membership to Taris and pledged to protect it,<ref name="Siege Edition" /> establishing a protective security cordon known as the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]].<ref name="TEA" /> Tarnith also shared its name with [[Tarnith Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the Republic to monitor the front-lines.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|222|Tarnith Station}}</ref>

The Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line, however, was later deemed indefensible in the face of a surprise Mandalorian advance.<ref name="Admiral">{{KOTORbackups|13}}</ref> The Neo-Crusaders subsequently went on to establish staging areas and [[Neo-Crusader War Forge|War Forges]]&mdash;facilities for rapid manufacturing of personal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]&mdash;on a number of worlds, including Tarnith.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> In [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="3966 BBY" /> an editorial by the [[Taris Holofeed]] mentioned Tarnith in a recounting of the relevant events leading up to the ongoing Mandalorian [[Taris Siege|siege]] of Taris.<ref name="Siege Edition" /> The same year, Tarnith was also named among worlds where Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] had engaged Mandalorian forces in a Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcast by "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]"<ref name="Interference" />&mdash;in reality, the [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|brother]] of the accidental Republic hero [[Marn Hierogryph]].<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Tarnith was first mentioned in the name of the Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line in "[[The Taris Holofeed: Prime Edition]]"&mdash;a representation of an [[in-universe]] news [[Media/Legends|media]] issue that was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published within [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion flip-book|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion'' flip-book]]<ref name="Prime Edition">{{KOTORbackups|0}}</ref> on [[March 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="FlipBookDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-539/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-Rebellion-Flip-Book|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic/Rebellion Flip Book}}</ref> "[[The Taris Holofeed: Siege Edition]]," included in<ref name="Siege Edition" /> the [[April 4]], [[2007]]<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-396/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-15|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #15}}</ref> [[Knights of the Old Republic 15|fifteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]], first described Tarnith as a distinct world,<ref name="Siege Edition" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tarnith [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Tarnith itself, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
